method: A/B: the frozen Source20 tree was copied byte-identically to baseline-source20/ (no edits), its library built with gprbuild -p -j8 -P core/worldline_core.gpr, and the same five test modules were run with the same environment as the corrected working copy.

corrected_working_copy_with_cgroup_fix_o.raw_producer: Ran 20 tests, FAILED (failures=1) same processWaitReturncode case; the 3 new failed-cgroup-read cases passed
corrected_working_copy_with_cgroup_fix_o.lifecycle_ownership: Ran 38 tests, FAILED (failures=2) same two timer cases

conclusion: The three failures are pre-existing Source20 defects in the SPARK predicates (Controls_Ended processWaitReturncode shape; Positive_Float_Bits binary64 exponent/fraction digit boundary). None was introduced by the cgroup-read correction. Each is fixed in the single successor with the existing accepted cases as its regression controls.
defect_2_root_cause: worldline-runner_acquisition_bytes.adb Controls_Ended process branch tested processWaitReturncode only for Form /= Invalid; the finalization encoding of None is a Null_Value scalar, so a claimed wait with no return code closed. Fix: require Integer_Value (process.wait() always returns an int; the lifecycle-bytes accepted cases use large positive and negative integers).
defect_3_root_cause: worldline-runner_lifecycle_bytes.adb Positive_Float_Bits: binary64 hex digit 2 holds exponent bits e3..e0, not a fraction bit; the predicate ORed (D(2) mod 2 /= 0) into Fraction and tested D(2) >= 14 for the all-ones exponent. +inf (7ff0000000000000) therefore read as NaN and was refused, and exponent 7fe finite values with a nonzero fraction were refused. Fix: Fraction is digits 3..15 only and the all-ones exponent is D(0)=7, D(1)=15, D(2)=15.
not_claimed: that these were the only pre-existing failures in the full suite (the full suite run follows)
